'''''Grunda Painting''''' was a [[Painting/Legends|painting]] made sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It was a painting made by the [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] painter [[Odoof Grunda]], depicting the late [[Sidoras Bey]] sculpting a statue of [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]].

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Grunda Painting'' is awarded to players after completing a quest. As the quest is repeatable, the player can also acquire multiple copies of the painting. Although the description implies that the painting depicted that of Sidoras Bey, the in-game appearance was the same as [[Ronka Plant]].
